versions.changelog:
Initial release of "bid-blind-bid-format-scanner" skill:

- Enables automated mechanical compliance scanning of "blind bid" (technical section) documents for format adherence before bid sealing or upload.
- Compares each requirement from the tender's "blind bid formatting requirements" to the current file, outputting a requirements vs. current status checklist, risk level (disqualifying or point-deducting), and one-click revision instructions.
- Scans full text and document metadata for any bidder-identifying information (name, logo, project manager, etc.).
- Only performs mechanical format checks; does not evaluate technical content quality or predict scores.
- Operates under strict safeguards: no file retention, explicit risk grading, no circumvention advice, and always prompts for manual review in edge cases.
